title: Before village
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：before　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 before 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the builder kept the beam ① before the rains at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the beam had been left ② before the whole village, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1953 puts it plainer. It was done ③ before the eyes of the doctor, and the assistant who kept the beam had laid it ④ before the judge twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done before the eyes of the doctor in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ before the cold weather, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ before the council; he was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ before the end of the week, and that the names be written ⑧ before the meeting. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried before the end of the week.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969 she kept the beam ⑨ before the rains again when nobody else would, and ⑩ before the whole village, she said in 1971, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot what had been done before the whole village.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之前（表时间：before the rains）
B. prep. 在…之前（表处所：before the whole village）
C. prep. 在…面前（表方式／状态：before the eyes of the doctor）
D. prep. 在…面前（引出施动者或相关的人：be laid before the judge）
E. prep. 在…之前（表原因：before the cold weather）
F. prep. 在…面前（表对象／目的：before the council）
G. prep. 在…之前（表工具／材料：before the end of the week）
H. prep. 在…面前（表载体／处所：written before the meeting）

items.q: before the eyes of the doctor
before the end of the week
before the whole village, she said

answers.why: before 意为“在…之前”，此处引出时间 the rains（雨季之前），说明那件短短的横梁是在何时留下的。
before 意为“在…之前”，此处引出处所 the whole village（全村人面前），说明东西被放在何处。
before 意为“在…面前”，此处引出方式或状态 the eyes of the doctor（大夫眼前），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
before 意为“在…面前”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 那位法官：be laid before the judge。
before 意为“在…之前”，此处引出原因 the cold weather（天冷的缘故），说明整件事由何而起。
before 意为“在…面前”，此处引出对象或目的 the council（议会面前）。
before 意为“在…之前”，此处引出工具或材料 the end of the week（周末之前）。
before 意为“在…面前”，此处引出载体 the meeting（那场会）：names written before the meeting。
before 意为“在…之前”，1969 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件短短的横梁，此处仍引出时间 the rains。
before 意为“在…之前”，母亲 1971 年那句话引出的仍是那一处全村人面前。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年雨季之前前后，施工员把那件短短的横梁留在了墙体。（before the rains）
那件短短的横梁被放在全村人面前，谁也没有过问。（before the whole village）
整件事是大夫眼前做成的，施工图上写得明白。（before the eyes of the doctor）
入冬之前，那件短短的横梁已经由那位法官砌过两回。（be laid before the judge）
叔叔说，整件事是由天冷的缘故起的。（before the cold weather）
他说，家里从来没有人为议会面前做过这件事。（before the council）
answers: In 1959 the builder kept the beam before the rains at the wall.
The beam had been left before the whole village, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done before the eyes of the doctor, or so the plan says.
The beam had been laid before the judge twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun before the cold weather.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it before the council.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 before 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the builder kept the beam before the rains, and nobody forgot it.
The beam had been left before the whole village for three months.
The work was done before the eyes of the doctor, as it always was in those days.
The beam had been laid before the judge twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the beam before the rains again when nobody else would.
The whole site never forgot what had been done before the whole village.
